Name: Rescue: Escape Pod over <Alias=TargetPlanetLocation>
MissionBoardDescription: Escape pod beacon over <Alias=TargetPlanetLocation>, one survivor, air running low. Pick him up and get him somewhere safe.

LogEntries.Entry: An escape pod is broadcasting over <Alias=TargetPlanetLocation>, one survivor aboard and his air running low. He needs picking up and taking somewhere safe.

LogEntries.Note: Player arrives in target system - update quest target

LogEntries.Entry: An escape pod over <Alias=TargetPlanetLocation> was broadcasting with one survivor and a day of air. I took him aboard, flew him to <Alias=FinalLocation> and saw him off.

Objectives.DisplayText: Go to any planet in the <Alias=TargetSystemLocation> system

Lines.ResponseText: When the ship went, everyone else got to the other pods first. I was the last one out, and mine went the wrong way. Where are we headed?
Somewhere safe. Sit down and breathe.
That I can do. Wake me if anything on this ship starts beeping.
The reactor went. We had about a minute.
I keep listening for the alarm. It's only habit now.
This is me. The first thing I'm doing is finding out who else made it.
So do I. You didn't fly past, you know. I won't forget that.
This is an escape pod, one aboard, and I've got air for maybe a day. If anyone's out there, I'm the little light that isn't moving. Please don't fly past.
